summary: I wrote src/main.ts. It draws a 1.5-unit cube with a metallic, rough MeshStandardMaterial (metalness 0.9, roughness 0.35) on a dark-grey background. Lighting is a procedural RoomEnvironment map, plus a key directional light and a bluish fill light. The cube rotates on its own every frame. OrbitControls with damping lets you drag to orbit around the cube while it rotates. The camera sits about 5 units from the cube, so the whole cube is centred in view. Rendering uses the existing 640x360 canvas at pixel ratio 1 with requestAnimationFrame, and `window.__EVAL_READY__` is set after the first frame. The typecheck passes. I did not run `vite build` or open the page in a browser, so the visuals are unchecked.
